name: system-maintenance
description: One-invocation native storage discovery, direct System 1 rubrics, explicit fallout and owner approval handoff.

interface.longDescription: A deterministic read-only runner collects native storage evidence and sends it directly to System 1, then writes eligible/protected/fallout tables for the agent's final analysis and owner handoff. Persistent sessions retain evidence, reviews and exact-plan approvals. Discovery never runs cleanup or invents missing facts.
defaultPrompt: system-maintenance:storage — discover recoverable space and report for approval
